/-- Everything an evaluation needs: the indexed trace with its reading, the bindings, and how to
    evaluate another rule's obligation (`rule id map`) under a variable map, per instant. -/
structure SemCtx where
  d : Primitives.Ctx
  β : Binding := {}
  /-- Another rule's verdict per instant under a variable map: complied-with when `engaged` is
      false, engaged (classes and applicability) when true. -/
  compose : String → List (String × String) → Binding → Bool → Array R :=
    fun _ _ _ _ => #[]

namespace SemCtx
def n (c : SemCtx) : Nat := c.d.n
def scenes (c : SemCtx) : Array Scene := c.d.scenes
def bindVar (c : SemCtx) (v : String) (x : Val) : SemCtx := { c with β := c.β.bind v x }
def mk' (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (β : Binding := {}) : SemCtx := { d := Primitives.Ctx.mk' τ ρ, β := β }
end SemCtx

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Arguments
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def resolve (β : Binding) : Arg → Except UnknownReason DArg
  | .var v =>
    match β.lookup v with
    | some (.track t) => .ok (.v t)
    | some (.region r) => .ok (.v r)
    | some (.device d) => .ok (.v d)
    | none => .error (.unboundVariable v)
  | .lit s => .ok (.s s)
  | .nat k => .ok (.n k)

def resolveAll (β : Binding) (args : List Arg) : Except UnknownReason (List DArg) := args.mapM (resolve β)

private def ent (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason Nat :=
  match a with | .v t => .ok t | .n k => .ok k | .s _ => .error (.malformed "entity expected")
private def lit (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason String :=
  match a with | .s s => .ok s | _ => .error (.malformed "literal expected")
private def enumLit {α : Type} (ofString : String → Option α) (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason α := do
  let s ← lit a
  match ofString s with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.malformed s)

private def b (o : Option Bool) (name : String) : R := R.ofOption o (.absentAtom name)
private def eqEnum {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (o : Option α) (v : α) (name : String) : R :=
  b (o.map (· == v)) name
private def q (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
private def qn (o : Option Nat) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat v)) | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
private def qz (o : Option Int) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok (Q.ofInt v) | none => .error (.absentAtom name)

def unknownAtom (n : String) : UnknownReason := .malformed s!"atom {n}"
def arity (n : String) : UnknownReason := .malformed s!"arity {n}"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Boolean atoms by name, on one scene. Class atoms (`ru_*`, `st_*`, `dev_*` kinds) are dispatched
-- through the generated codecs, so the table cannot drift from ATOMS.md; attribute atoms are listed.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def evalAtomE (s : Scene) (name : String) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) : Except UnknownReason R := do
  match name, args with
  -- road users
  | "ru_subject", [x] => pure (b (ru_subject s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_aggregate", [_, .s w] => .error (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{w}")   -- resolved with the reading in `evalAll`
  | "ru_rider_posture", [x, f] =>
    match f with
    | .s "on_seat" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_on_seat s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "standing_on_deck" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "holding_another_vehicle" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "stunt" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_stunt s (← ent x)) name)
    | _ => .error (.malformed "posture field")
  | "ru_rider_posture_on_seat", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_on_seat s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_stunt", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_stunt s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_emergency_vehicle_kind", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (ru_emergency_vehicle_kind s (← ent x)) (← enumLit EmergencyKind.ofString k) name)
  | "ru_official_vehicle_kind", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (ru_official_vehicle_kind s (← ent x)) (← enumLit OfficialKind.ofString k) name)
  -- control state
  | "kin_engine_running", [x] => pure (b (kin_engine_running s (← ent x)) name)
  | "kin_parking_brake", [x] => pure (b (kin_parking_brake s (← ent x)) name)
  -- structure attributes
  | "st_road_edge_paved", [r] => pure (b (st_road_edge_paved s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_shoulder_paved", [r] => pure (b (st_shoulder_paved s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_median_or_divider_opening", [r] => pure (b (st_median_or_divider_opening s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_crosswalk_marked", [r] => pure (b (st_crosswalk_marked s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_reserved_lane_class", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_reserved_lane_class s (← ent r)) (← enumLit ReservedClass.ofString k) name)
  | "st_turn_lane_side", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_turn_lane_side s (← ent r)) (← enumLit TurnSide.ofString k) name)
  | "st_parking_space_designation", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_parking_space_designation s (← ent r)) (← enumLit ParkingDesignation.ofString k) name)
  | "st_curb_zone_kind", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_curb_zone_kind s (← ent r)) (← enumLit CurbZoneKind.ofString k) name)
  | "st_curb_zone_colour", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_curb_zone_colour s (← ent r)) (← enumLit CurbColour.ofString k) name)
  | "st_obstruction_kind", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_obstruction_kind s (← ent r)) (← enumLit ObstructionKind.ofString k) name)
  | "st_lane_adjacency", [r, sd, r'] =>
    match sd with
    | .s "left" => pure (b (st_lane_left_of s (← ent r) (← ent r')) name)
    | .s "right" => pure (b (st_lane_right_of s (← ent r) (← ent r')) name)
    | _ => .error (.malformed "side")
  | "st_lane_adjacency_left", [r, r'] => pure (b (st_lane_left_of s (← ent r) (← ent r')) name)
  | "st_lane_adjacency_right", [r, r'] => pure (b (st_lane_right_of s (← ent r) (← ent r')) name)
  | "st_lane_connectivity", [r, r'] => pure (b ((st_lane_connectivity s (← ent r)).map (·.contains (← ent r'))) name)
  | "st_lane_enters", [r, i] => pure (b ((st_lane_enters s (← ent r)).map (· == (← ent i))) name)
  | "st_on_way", [r, w] => pure (b ((st_on_way s (← ent r)).map (·.contains (← ent w))) name)
  | "st_entrance_of", [l, a] => pure (b (st_entrance_of s (← ent l) (← ent a)) name)
  | "st_lane_marking", [r, sd, t] =>
    match sd with
    | .s "left" => pure (eqEnum ((st_lane_marking_left s (← ent r)).map (·.1)) (← enumLit MarkingType.ofString t) name)
    | .s "right" => pure (eqEnum ((st_lane_marking_right s (← ent r)).map (·.1)) (← enumLit MarkingType.ofString t) name)
    | _ => .error (.malformed "side")
  | "st_lane_marking", [r, sd, t, col] =>
    let m ← match sd with
      | .s "left" => pure (st_lane_marking_left s (← ent r))
      | .s "right" => pure (st_lane_marking_right s (← ent r))
      | _ => .error (.malformed "side")
    pure (R.and (eqEnum (m.map (·.1)) (← enumLit MarkingType.ofString t) name)
                (eqEnum (m.map (·.2)) (← enumLit MarkingColour.ofString col) name))
  | "st_lane_marking_left", [r, t] => pure (eqEnum ((st_lane_marking_left s (← ent r)).map (·.1)) (← enumLit MarkingType.ofString t) name)
  | "st_lane_marking_right", [r, t] => pure (eqEnum ((st_lane_marking_right s (← ent r)).map (·.1)) (← enumLit MarkingType.ofString t) name)
  | "rel_occupies", [x, r] => pure (b (rel_occupies s (← ent x) (← ent r)) name)
  -- devices
  | "dev_traffic_signal_shows", [d, k] => pure (b (dev_traffic_signal_shows s (← ent d) (← enumLit SignalIndication.ofString k)) name)
  | "dev_traffic_signal_uncovered", [d] => pure (b (dev_traffic_signal_uncovered s (← ent d)) name)
  | "dev_pedestrian_signal_state", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_pedestrian_signal_state s (← ent d)) (← enumLit PedSignalState.ofString k) name)
  | "dev_pedestrian_signal_countdown", [d] => pure (b (dev_pedestrian_signal_countdown s (← ent d)) name)
  | "dev_lane_control_signal_state", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_lane_control_signal_state s (← ent d)) (← enumLit LaneControlState.ofString k) name)
  | "dev_speed_limit_beacon_flashing", [d] => pure (b (dev_speed_limit_beacon_flashing s (← ent d)) name)
  | "dev_crossing_warning_signal_active", [d] => pure (b (dev_crossing_warning_signal_active s (← ent d)) name)
  | "dev_speed_limit_sign_kind", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_speed_limit_sign_kind s (← ent d)) (← enumLit SpeedSignKind.ofString k) name)
  | "dev_regulatory_sign_code", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_regulatory_sign_code s (← ent d)) (← enumLit SignCode.ofString k) name)
  | "dev_zone_sign_kind", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_zone_sign_kind s (← ent d)) (← enumLit ZoneKind.ofString k) name)
  | "dev_zone_sign_end", [d] => pure (b (dev_zone_sign_end s (← ent d)) name)
  | "dev_railway_signal_or_gate_lights", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_railway_signal_or_gate_lights s (← ent d)) (← enumLit RailLights.ofString k) name)
  | "dev_railway_signal_or_gate_gate", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_railway_signal_or_gate_gate s (← ent d)) (← enumLit GateState.ofString k) name)
  | "dev_railway_signal_or_gate_bell", [d] => pure (b (dev_railway_signal_or_gate_bell s (← ent d)) name)
  | "dev_human_direction_role", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_human_direction_role s (← ent d)) (← enumLit HumanRole.ofString k) name)
  | "dev_human_direction_indication", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_human_direction_indication s (← ent d)) (← enumLit HumanIndication.ofString k) name)
  | "dev_governs", [d, r] => pure (b (dev_governs s (← ent d) (← ent r)) name)
  | "dev_inoperative", [d] => pure (b (dev_inoperative s (← ent d)) name)
  -- signals emitted
  | "sig_turn_indicator", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (sig_turn_indicator s (← ent x)) (← enumLit TurnIndicatorState.ofString k) name)
  | "sig_brake_lamp", [x] => pure (b (sig_brake_lamp s (← ent x)) name)
  | "sig_hazard", [x] => pure (b (sig_hazard s (← ent x)) name)
  | "sig_headlamp", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (sig_headlamp s (← ent x)) (← enumLit HeadlampState.ofString k) name)
  | "sig_position_lamp", [x] => pure (b (sig_position_lamp s (← ent x)) name)
  | "sig_warning_lamp", [x, col] => pure (b (sig_warning_lamp_colour s (← ent x) (← enumLit LampColour.ofString col)) name)
  | "sig_warning_lamp", [x, col, m] => pure (b (sig_warning_lamp_shows s (← ent x) (← enumLit LampColour.ofString col) (← enumLit LampMode.ofString m)) name)
  | "sig_siren", [x] => pure (b (sig_siren s (← ent x)) name)
  | "sig_horn", [x] => pure (b (sig_horn s (← ent x)) name)
  | "sig_hand_signal", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (sig_hand_signal s (← ent x)) (← enumLit HandSignal.ofString k) name)
  | "sig_door_open", [x] => pure (b ((sig_door_open s (← ent x)).map (!·.isEmpty)) name)
  | "sig_door_open", [x, k] => pure (b (sig_door_open_side s (← ent x) (← enumLit DoorSide.ofString k)) name)
  | "sig_compression_brake", [x] => pure (b (sig_compression_brake s (← ent x)) name)
  -- environment
  | "env_darkness", [] => pure (b (env_darkness s) name)
  | "env_precipitation", [] => pure (b (env_precipitation s) name)
  | "env_wet_road", [] => pure (b (env_wet_road s) name)
  | "env_ice_or_snow", [] => pure (b (env_ice_or_snow s) name)
  -- relations
  | "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane", [a, a'] => pure (b (rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
  | "rel_ahead_in_lane", [a, a'] => pure (b (rel_ahead_in_lane s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
  | "rel_behind_in_lane", [a, a'] => pure (b (rel_behind_in_lane s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
  | "rel_oncoming", [a, a'] =>
    match ps with
    | [tol] => pure (b (rel_oncoming s (← ent a) (← ent a') tol) name)
    | _ => .error (.parameterMissing "rel_oncoming cosine tolerance")
  | "rel_same_direction", [a, a'] =>
    match ps with
    | [tol] => pure (b (rel_same_direction s (← ent a) (← ent a') tol) name)
    | _ => .error (.parameterMissing "rel_same_direction cosine tolerance")
  | "rel_bearing", [a, a', k] =>
    match k with
    | .s "ahead" => pure (b (rel_bearing_ahead s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
    | .s "behind" => pure (b (rel_bearing_behind s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
    | .s "left" => pure (b (rel_bearing_left s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
    | .s "right" => pure (b (rel_bearing_right s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
    | _ => .error (.malformed "bearing side")
  | "rel_contact", [a, a'] => pure (b (rel_contact s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)

  | .s "y" => q (v.map (·.2)) name

  | "kin_yaw_rate", [x] => q (kin_yaw_rate s (← ent x)) name

    | .s "width" => q (e.map fun (_, w, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) w) name

  | "ru_electric_bicycle_class", [x] => qn (ru_electric_bicycle_class s (← ent x)) name
  | "st_lane_direction", [r, k] => comp ((st_lane_direction s (← ent r)).bind Geom.unit) k name
  | "st_lane_adjacency", [r, k] =>
    match k with
    | .s "ordinal" => qn (st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s (← ent r)) name

    | d :: ds =>

      cs.filter fun c => Q.eq (normSq (vsub p c)) m
/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when

content.content:
150	/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when
151	    they share a point (`polygonsOverlap`), otherwise the shortest vector joining a vertex of one to
152	    the nearest point of the other's boundary, which for two convex polygons is the same for every
153	    nearest pair. `none` for an empty polygon. -/
154	def nearestOffset (p q : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
155	  if polygonsOverlap p q then some (Q.zero, Q.zero)
156	  else
157	    let fromP := p.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c q).map (vsub · c)
158	    let fromQ := q.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c p).map (vsub c ·)
159	    (fromP ++ fromQ).foldl (fun acc d => match acc with
160	      | none => some d
161	      | some e => if Q.lt (normSq d) (normSq e) then some d else some e) none
162	/-- The interval a polygon covers along the direction `u`, measured from `o`: (lowest, highest). -/
163	def span (u o : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option (Q × Q) :=
164	  match poly.map fun c => dot u (vsub c o) with
165	  | [] => none
166	  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldl Q.min x, xs.foldl Q.max x)
167	/-- Twice the signed area of a polygon (the shoelace sum). -/
168	def area2 (poly : List Vec) : Q :=
169	  (edges poly).foldl (fun acc (a, b) => Q.add acc (cross a b)) Q.zero
170	/-- Whether a polygon's boundary crosses or touches itself: two edges that are not neighbours
171	    meet, or two neighbouring edges fold back along one line. -/
172	def selfIntersects (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
173	  let es := (edges poly).toArray
174	  let n := es.size
175	  (List.range n).any fun i => (List.range n).any fun j =>
176	    if j ≤ i then false
177	    else
178	      let (a, b) := es[i]!
179	      let (c, d) := es[j]!
180	      if j == i + 1 then orient a b d == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub b a) (vsub d c)) Q.zero
181	      else if i == 0 && j + 1 == n then orient c d b == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub d c) (vsub b a)) Q.zero
182	      else segmentsIntersect a b c d
183	/-- A simple polygon: at least three vertices, a non-zero area, and a boundary that neither crosses
184	    nor touches itself (a repeated vertex makes two edges that are not neighbours meet). -/
185	def simplePolygon (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
186	  poly.length ≥ 3 && !Q.isZero (area2 poly) && !selfIntersects poly
187	/-- Whether a point lies on a polygon's boundary. Exact. -/
188	def onBoundary (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
189	  (edges poly).any fun (a, b) => orient a b p == 0 && withinBox p a b
190	/-- The parameters `t` at which the line `p + t·u` meets the polygon's boundary: one per edge it
191	    crosses or touches, and both ends of an edge it runs along. `u` is not the zero vector. -/
192	def lineCrossings (p u : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Q :=
193	  (edges poly).flatMap fun (a, b) =>
194	    let d := vsub b a
195	    let w := vsub a p
196	    let den := cross u d
197	    if Q.isZero den then
198	      if Q.isZero (cross u w) then [Q.div (dot w u) (dot u u), Q.div (dot (vsub b p) u) (dot u u)] else []
199	    else
200	      let s := Q.div (cross w u) den
201	      if Q.le Q.zero s && Q.le s (Q.ofInt 1) then [Q.div (cross w d) den] else []
202	end Geom

277	/-- Whether kind `a` refines kind `b`, reflexively and transitively. -/
278	def StructureKind.refines (a b : StructureKind) : Bool := a == b || a.ancestors.contains b
279	
280	/-- Whether a source that cannot tell kind `m` (it is among `unobservedKinds`) leaves this structure's
281	    membership of `m`'s kinds open: always where `m` refines no kind other than an abstract one;
282	    otherwise only where the structure is labelled `m` or a kind `m` refines, since a structure of any
283	    other kind is known not to be one. -/
284	def Structure.maskApplies (st : Structure) (m : StructureKind) : Bool :=
285	  (m.parent?.filter (!·.isAbstract)).isNone || m.refines st.kind
286	
287	/-- Whether a structure is of kind `k`: unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
288	    structure, is `k` or a kind `k` refines (the label cannot be trusted for `k`); true where the
289	    structure's kind refines `k`; unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
290	    structure, refines `k`; false otherwise. A parent never implies a kind refining it, two kinds
291	    refining one parent never imply each other, and a kind the source cannot tell never makes a known
292	    parent unknown. An abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it: true where the structure
293	    is of one of them, unknown where it is of none and unknown for one, false otherwise. -/
294	def Structure.isOfKind (st : Structure) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
295	  let masked := st.unobservedKinds.filter st.maskApplies
296	  let concrete (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
297	    if masked.any (k.refines ·) then none
298	    else if st.kind.refines k then some true
299	    else if masked.any (·.refines k) then none
300	    else some false
301	  if k.isAbstract then
302	    let vs := (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k)).map concrete
303	    if vs.contains (some true) then some true else if vs.contains none then none else some false
304	  else concrete k

402	/-- The rectangle a road user's body covers on the ground, from its position, heading and
403	    half-extents; `none` when one of them is not observed. -/
404	def footprint (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List Vec) := do
405	  let p ← kin_position s x
406	  let h ← kin_heading s x
407	  let (hl, hw, _) ← kin_extent s x
408	  let u ← Geom.unit h
409	  let v := (Q.neg u.2, u.1)
410	  let corner (a b : Q) : Vec := Geom.vadd p (Q.add (Q.mul a u.1) (Q.mul b v.1), Q.add (Q.mul a u.2) (Q.mul b v.2))
411	  pure [corner hl hw, corner hl (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) hw]

413	/-- Ground distance from a road user's body to a region: zero when the footprint overlaps the
414	    boundary, otherwise the nearest approach between the two outlines. Without a footprint (no
415	    extent or heading observed) the reference point is used; a point-like structure is measured
416	    to its reference point. -/
417	def st_region_geometry_distance (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Q := do
418	  let p ← kin_position s x
419	  match st_region_geometry_boundary s r, footprint s x with
420	  | some poly, some fp =>
421	    if Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some Q.zero
422	    else
423	      let ds := fp.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · poly) ++ poly.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · fp)
424	      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
425	  | some poly, none => Geom.polygonDistance p poly
426	  | none, fp =>
427	    let c ← st_region_geometry_position s r
428	    match fp with
429	    | some poly => Geom.polygonDistance c poly
430	    | none => some (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub c p))

590	/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
591	    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by

598	    let pa ← kin_position s a
599	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
600	    let u ← Geom.unit ha
601	    let fa ← footprint s a
602	    let fb ← footprint s b
603	    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
604	    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
605	    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))

607	/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
608	def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
609	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
610	  | some v => some v
611	  | none => do
612	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
613	    let hb ← kin_heading s b
614	    let pa ← kin_position s a
615	    let pb ← kin_position s b
616	    let va ← kin_velocity s a
617	    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
618	    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
619	    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
620	    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
621	    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)

641	def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
642	def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero
643

645	def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=

    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    let va ← kin_velocity s a
    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)

/-- Headings aligned (cosine above `cosTol`). -/
def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)

/-- `b` relative to `a` in `a`'s frame: (longitudinal, lateral), lateral positive to the left. -/
def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => relFrame s a b
def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero

/-- The bodies touch or overlap. -/
def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.contact) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero

/-- `b` is in `a`'s line of sight, as the source tested it; never computed. -/
def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)

end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
  The temporal operators over a whole trace at once: every operator maps per-instant arrays to a
  per-instant array in one pass (or one pass plus O(1) window queries), so a formula costs
  O(|φ| · n log n) per grounding. Semantics and Derived both use these; nothing here knows what
  a formula or a road user is.

  Finite-trace policy: the unobserved past and future are unknown (`windowTruncated`), never a
  verdict. A lookback window must be covered and adequately sampled; a lookahead window is true
  on a witness, false only when covered.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Temporal

def const (n : Nat) (r : R) : Array R := Array.replicate n r
def truncated (op : String) : R := R.u (.windowTruncated op)

-- pointwise connectives
def zipAnd (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.and a b
def zipOr (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.or a b
def zipImplies (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.implies a b
def mapNot (a : Array R) : Array R := a.map R.not
def allOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipAnd (const n R.t)
def anyOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipOr (const n R.f)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Unbounded operators: one backward or forward pass with the unobserved tail as unknown.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n tail, tail)).1

private def forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n head, head)).1

/-- `always φ`: φ here and at every later observation, and the unobserved future. -/
def alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "always") R.and φ
/-- `eventually φ`: φ here or later, or the unobserved future. -/
def eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "eventually") R.or φ
/-- Strong until: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ until')`, the unobserved future as the tail. -/
def untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "until"), truncated "until")).1
/-- Since: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ since')`, the unobserved past as the head. -/
def sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "since"), truncated "since")).1
/-- `once φ`: φ here or at some earlier observation, or the unobserved past. -/
def onceAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := forward (truncated "once") (fun v acc => R.or v acc) φ
/-- φ at the previous observation (`first` at the trace start). -/
def prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i => if i = 0 then first else φ[i - 1]!

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Metric windows: positions per instant (time or path), a length d, per-instant values.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- φ at every observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant. Unknown where a
    position inside the window is missing; where the window is not covered, false on a false
    already observed inside it and unknown otherwise; unknown where it is covered but not
    adequately sampled. -/
def holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.covered then (if (agg.all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
      else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else agg.all w.j0 i

/-- The value of φ at the latest observation `j` in `[j0, i]` at which ψ held: unknown where ψ is
    unknown at an observation later than any at which it held; none where ψ held nowhere in the range. -/
private def atLastAt (ψ φ : Array R) (j0 i : Nat) : Option R :=
  (List.range (i + 1 - j0)).foldl (fun (acc : Option R) k =>
    match acc with
    | some r => some r
    | none =>
      let j := i - k
      match ψ[j]!.v with
      | .t => some φ[j]!
      | .u => some ⟨.u, ψ[j]!.why⟩
      | .f => none) none

/-- φ at the last observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant at which ψ held.
    Unknown where a position is missing, where ψ is unknown later than any observation at which it
    held, where the window is not adequately sampled (an unobserved later instant could be the last
    one at which ψ held), and where ψ held nowhere in a window that is not covered; false where ψ
    held nowhere in a covered, adequately sampled window. -/
def atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      match atLastAt ψ φ w.j0 i with
      | some r => if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else r
      | none => if !w.covered then truncated op else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else R.f

/-- φ at some observation in the window of length `d` ahead: true on a witness, false only when
    the window is covered, unknown when it runs off the trace. -/
def withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let a := agg.any i w.jl
        if w.covered then a else R.or a (truncated op)

/-- Smallest `k ≥ i` whose value satisfies `p` (size when none), per instant. -/
def nextWhere (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
  let n := vals.size
  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.set! i (if p vals[i]!.v then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)

/-- Strong until restricted to the window ahead: ∃ j in the window, ψ at j and φ at every
    observation from here to just before j; the unobserved remainder counts as unknown unless φ
    already failed. -/
def untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let aggφ := RangeAgg.build φ
  let aggψ := RangeAgg.build ψ
  let firstψ := nextWhere ψ (· = .t)
  let firstφf := nextWhere φ (· = .f)

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
3	  Metric windows without a frame rate.
4	
5	  Every observation carries a timestamp; a body also carries the path length it has travelled.
6	  A window is measured in one of the two: a duration of time, or a length of path travelled.
7	  Semantics are defined on the OBSERVED instants only; the one interpolation-free precondition is
8	  adequacy: a window of length d over a span is adequate when consecutive observations in the
9	  span are at most d/2 apart. An inadequate span yields `unknown`
10	  with the reason `samplingGap`, never a verdict invented between frames.
11	
12	  Windows are computed for every instant of a trace at once: positions are monotone, so the
13	  window boundary moves one way and a two-pointer sweep with a range-maximum table over the gaps
14	  gives every window in O(n log n).
15	
16	  There is no `next`, no rate and no frame count anywhere in the library.
17	-/
18	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units
19	
20	namespace TrafficSpec
21	
22	/-- Milliseconds, monotone within a trace. -/
23	abbrev Timestamp := Int
24	
25	/-- Which quantity a window is measured in. -/
26	inductive Measure
27	  | time | path
28	  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited
29	
30	/-- A window: a non-negative length in seconds (time) or metres (path). -/
31	structure Duration where
32	  measure : Measure
33	  length : Q
34	  deriving Repr
35	
36	namespace Duration
37	def time (q : Q) : Duration := ⟨.time, q⟩
38	def path (q : Q) : Duration := ⟨.path, q⟩
39	end Duration
40	
41	namespace Time
42	
43	def ofTimestamp (t : Timestamp) : Q := Units.milliseconds t
44	
45	/-- Consecutive gaps of a sorted list of positions (time or path). -/
46	def gaps : List Q → List Q
47	  | a :: b :: rest => Q.sub b a :: gaps (b :: rest)
48	  | _ => []
49	
50	/-- Every consecutive gap in the span is at most `d / 2`. Vacuously true on one observation. -/
51	def adequate (d : Q) (span : List Q) : Bool :=
52	  (gaps span).all (fun g => Q.le g (Q.half d))
53	
54	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
55	-- Range maximum over the gaps between consecutive observed positions (sparse table).
56	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
57	/-- `gapMax.query lo hi` is the largest gap `pos[k] - pos[k-1]` for `lo < k ≤ hi`, given that
58	    every position in `[lo, hi]` is observed. -/
59	structure GapMax where
60	  table : Array (Array Q)      -- table[k][j] = max of gaps[j .. j + 2^k)
61	  gapsArr : Array Q            -- gapsArr[k] = pos[k+1] - pos[k], or zero where a side is missing
62	
63	namespace GapMax
64	def log2 (n : Nat) : Nat := if n ≤ 1 then 0 else 1 + log2 (n / 2)
65	
66	def build (pos : Array (Option Q)) : GapMax :=
67	  let n := pos.size
68	  let g : Array Q := (Array.range (n - 1)).map fun k =>
69	    match pos[k]?, pos[k + 1]? with
70	    | some (some a), some (some b) => Q.sub b a
71	    | _, _ => Q.zero
72	  let levels := log2 (max 1 g.size) + 1
73	  let table := (List.range levels).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Array Q)) k =>
74	    if k == 0 then #[g]
75	    else
76	      let prev := acc[k - 1]!
77	      let half := 2 ^ (k - 1)
78	      let row := (Array.range (prev.size)).map fun j =>
79	        if j + half < prev.size then Q.max prev[j]! prev[j + half]! else prev[j]!
80	      acc.push row) #[]
81	  ⟨table, g⟩
82	
83	/-- Largest gap among the observations `lo, …, hi` (`lo < hi`); zero for a single observation. -/
84	def query (m : GapMax) (lo hi : Nat) : Q :=
85	  if hi ≤ lo then Q.zero
86	  else
87	    let len := hi - lo                  -- gaps indices lo … hi-1
88	    let k := log2 len
89	    let row := m.table[k]!
90	    Q.max row[lo]! row[hi - 2 ^ k]!
91	end GapMax
92	
93	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
94	-- Windows for every instant
95	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
96	/-- The window behind an instant: the oldest in-window index, whether the trace reaches back past
97	    the window (an observation precedes it, or the oldest is exactly `d` behind), and whether the
98	    observations inside are at most `d/2` apart. -/
99	structure Back where
100	  j0 : Nat
101	  covered : Bool
102	  adequate : Bool
103	  deriving Repr
104	
105	/-- The window ahead of an instant, symmetrically. -/
106	structure Fwd where
107	  jl : Nat
108	  covered : Bool
109	  adequate : Bool
110	  deriving Repr
111	
112	/-- Index of the earliest missing position at or after `i`, per instant (size n+1; `n` when none). -/
113	private def nextMissing (pos : Array (Option Q)) : Array Nat :=
114	  let n := pos.size
115	  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
116	    let v := if (pos[i]?).getD none |>.isNone then i else acc[i + 1]!
117	    acc.set! i v) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
118	
119	/-- Every back window of length `d`. `none` where the instant's own position or a position inside
120	    its window is missing (a gap the adequacy test could not see). Covered means an observed
121	    position precedes the window, or its oldest observation is exactly `d` behind. -/
122	def backWindows (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) : Array (Option Back) :=
123	  let n := pos.size
124	  let gm := GapMax.build pos
125	  let nm := nextMissing pos
126	  -- observedBefore[j]: some position at an index < j is observed
127	  let observedBefore : Array Bool := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Bool) j =>
128	    acc.push (acc[j]! || (pos[j]!).isSome)) #[false]
129	  let step (st : Nat × Array (Option Back)) (i : Nat) : Nat × Array (Option Back) :=
130	    let (j0, out) := st
131	    match pos[i]! with
132	    | none => (j0, out.push none)
133	    | some pi =>
134	      -- advance the oldest index while its position is observed and more than d behind
135	      let rec adv (j : Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Nat :=
136	        match fuel with
137	        | 0 => j
138	        | fuel + 1 =>
139	          if j ≥ i then j
140	          else match pos[j]! with
141	            | some pj => if Q.gt (Q.sub pi pj) d then adv (j + 1) fuel else j
142	            | none => adv (j + 1) fuel
143	      let j0' := adv j0 (i + 1 - j0)
144	      -- a missing position between j0' and i makes the window unknown
145	      if nm[j0']! ≤ i then (j0', out.push none)
146	      else
147	        let p0 := (pos[j0']!).getD pi

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
  Metric windows without a frame rate.

  Every observation carries a timestamp; a body also carries the path length it has travelled.
  A window is measured in one of the two: a duration of time, or a length of path travelled.
  Semantics are defined on the OBSERVED instants only; the one interpolation-free precondition is
  adequacy: a window of length d over a span is adequate when consecutive observations in the
  span are at most d/2 apart. An inadequate span yields `unknown`
  with the reason `samplingGap`, never a verdict invented between frames.

  Windows are computed for every instant of a trace at once: positions are monotone, so the
  window boundary moves one way and a two-pointer sweep with a range-maximum table over the gaps
  gives every window in O(n log n).

  There is no `next`, no rate and no frame count anywhere in the library.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units

namespace TrafficSpec

/-- Milliseconds, monotone within a trace. -/
abbrev Timestamp := Int

/-- Which quantity a window is measured in. -/
inductive Measure
  | time | path
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited

/-- A window: a non-negative length in seconds (time) or metres (path). -/
structure Duration where
  measure : Measure
  length : Q
  deriving Repr

namespace Duration
def time (q : Q) : Duration := ⟨.time, q⟩
def path (q : Q) : Duration := ⟨.path, q⟩
end Duration

namespace Time

def ofTimestamp (t : Timestamp) : Q := Units.milliseconds t

/-- Consecutive gaps of a sorted list of positions (time or path). -/
def gaps : List Q → List Q
  | a :: b :: rest => Q.sub b a :: gaps (b :: rest)
  | _ => []

/-- Every consecutive gap in the span is at most `d / 2`. Vacuously true on one observation. -/
def adequate (d : Q) (span : List Q) : Bool :=
  (gaps span).all (fun g => Q.le g (Q.half d))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Range maximum over the gaps between consecutive observed positions (sparse table).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- `gapMax.query lo hi` is the largest gap `pos[k] - pos[k-1]` for `lo < k ≤ hi`, given that
    every position in `[lo, hi]` is observed. -/
structure GapMax where
  table : Array (Array Q)      -- table[k][j] = max of gaps[j .. j + 2^k)
  gapsArr : Array Q            -- gapsArr[k] = pos[k+1] - pos[k], or zero where a side is missing

namespace GapMax
def log2 (n : Nat) : Nat := if n ≤ 1 then 0 else 1 + log2 (n / 2)

def build (pos : Array (Option Q)) : GapMax :=
  let n := pos.size
  let g : Array Q := (Array.range (n - 1)).map fun k =>
    match pos[k]?, pos[k + 1]? with
    | some (some a), some (some b) => Q.sub b a
    | _, _ => Q.zero
  let levels := log2 (max 1 g.size) + 1
  let table := (List.range levels).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Array Q)) k =>
    if k == 0 then #[g]
    else
      let prev := acc[k - 1]!
      let half := 2 ^ (k - 1)
      let row := (Array.range (prev.size)).map fun j =>
        if j + half < prev.size then Q.max prev[j]! prev[j + half]! else prev[j]!
      acc.push row) #[]
  ⟨table, g⟩

/-- Largest gap among the observations `lo, …, hi` (`lo < hi`); zero for a single observation. -/
def query (m : GapMax) (lo hi : Nat) : Q :=
  if hi ≤ lo then Q.zero
  else
    let len := hi - lo                  -- gaps indices lo … hi-1
    let k := log2 len
    let row := m.table[k]!
    Q.max row[lo]! row[hi - 2 ^ k]!
end GapMax

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Windows for every instant
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The window behind an instant: the oldest in-window index, whether the trace reaches back past
    the window (an observation precedes it, or the oldest is exactly `d` behind), and whether the
    observations inside are at most `d/2` apart. -/
structure Back where
  j0 : Nat
  covered : Bool
  adequate : Bool
  deriving Repr

/-- The window ahead of an instant, symmetrically. -/
structure Fwd where
  jl : Nat
  covered : Bool
  adequate : Bool
  deriving Repr

/-- Index of the earliest missing position at or after `i`, per instant (size n+1; `n` when none). -/
private def nextMissing (pos : Array (Option Q)) : Array Nat :=
  let n := pos.size
  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    let v := if (pos[i]?).getD none |>.isNone then i else acc[i + 1]!
    acc.set! i v) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)

/-- Every back window of length `d`. `none` where the instant's own position or a position inside
    its window is missing (a gap the adequacy test could not see). Covered means an observed
    position precedes the window, or its oldest observation is exactly `d` behind. -/
def backWindows (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) : Array (Option Back) :=
  let n := pos.size
  let gm := GapMax.build pos
  let nm := nextMissing pos
  -- observedBefore[j]: some position at an index < j is observed
  let observedBefore : Array Bool := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Bool) j =>
    acc.push (acc[j]! || (pos[j]!).isSome)) #[false]
  let step (st : Nat × Array (Option Back)) (i : Nat) : Nat × Array (Option Back) :=
    let (j0, out) := st
    match pos[i]! with
    | none => (j0, out.push none)
    | some pi =>
      -- advance the oldest index while its position is observed and more than d behind
      let rec adv (j : Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Nat :=
        match fuel with
        | 0 => j
        | fuel + 1 =>
          if j ≥ i then j
          else match pos[j]! with
            | some pj => if Q.gt (Q.sub pi pj) d then adv (j + 1) fuel else j
            | none => adv (j + 1) fuel
      let j0' := adv j0 (i + 1 - j0)
      -- a missing position between j0' and i makes the window unknown
      if nm[j0']! ≤ i then (j0', out.push none)
      else
        let p0 := (pos[j0']!).getD pi
        let covered := observedBefore[j0']! || Q.ge (Q.sub pi p0) d
        let adequate := Q.le (gm.query j0' i) (Q.half d)
        (j0', out.push (some ⟨j0', covered, adequate⟩))
  ((List.range n).foldl step (0, Array.mkEmpty n)).2

/-- Every forward window of length `d`, by the same sweep run backwards. -/
def forwardWindows (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) : Array (Option Fwd) :=
  let n := pos.size
  let gm := GapMax.build pos
  -- observedFrom[j]: some position at an index ≥ j is observed (size n+1; false at n)
  let observedFrom : Array Bool := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Bool) j =>
    acc.set! j (acc[j + 1]! || (pos[j]!).isSome)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) false)
  -- index of the latest missing position at or before i (n when none), per instant
  let lastMissing : Array Nat := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    let v := if (pos[i]!).isNone then i else (if i = 0 then n else acc[i - 1]!)
    acc.push v) (Array.mkEmpty n)
  let step (st : Nat × List (Option Fwd)) (i : Nat) : Nat × List (Option Fwd) :=
    let (jl, out) := st
    match pos[i]! with
    | none => (jl, none :: out)
    | some pi =>
      let rec adv (j : Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Nat :=
        match fuel with
        | 0 => j
        | fuel + 1 =>
          if j ≤ i then j
          else match pos[j]! with
            | some pj => if Q.gt (Q.sub pj pi) d then adv (j - 1) fuel else j
            | none => adv (j - 1) fuel
      let jl' := adv jl (jl + 1 - i)
      let lm := lastMissing[jl']!
      if lm ≠ n && lm ≥ i then (jl', none :: out)
      else
        let pl := (pos[jl']!).getD pi
        let covered := observedFrom[jl' + 1]! || Q.ge (Q.sub pl pi) d
        let adequate := Q.le (gm.query i jl') (Q.half d)
        (jl', (some ⟨jl', covered, adequate⟩) :: out)
  (((List.range n).reverse).foldl step (n - 1, [])).2.toArray

end Time
end TrafficSpec

import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.LVMC_11_12_070_B

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/

/-- The reading's parameters; no value of any of them lives in this file. -/
def pConflictCentreClearance : Term := .param "p.conflict_centre_clearance"
def pConflictHorizon : Term := .param "p.conflict_horizon"
def pHaltSpeedTolerance : Term := .param "p.halt_speed_tolerance"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

def vehicleAggregate : String := "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"

/-- ru.aggregate: x is a vehicle (DEF-NRS-484A-320). -/
def isVehicle (x : String) : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [.var x, .lit vehicleAggregate] []

/-- rel.occupies. -/
def occupies (x r : String) : Formula := .atom "rel_occupies" [.var x, .var r] []

/-- st.lane_enters: carrier c is an approach to intersection j. -/
def entersJ (c j : String) : Formula := .atom "st_lane_enters" [.var c, .var j] []

/-- dev.governs. -/
def governs (d r : String) : Formula := .atom "dev_governs" [.var d, .var r] []

/-- A stop sign governs r. -/
def stopSignOn (r d : String) : Formula := .existsDevice (.lit "stop_sign") d (governs d r)

/-- A yield sign governs r. -/
def yieldSignOn (r d : String) : Formula := .existsDevice (.lit "yield_sign") d (governs d r)

/-- A traffic signal showing flashing_red governs r. -/
def flashingRedOn (r d : String) : Formula :=
  .existsDevice (.lit "traffic_signal") d
    (.and (governs d r) (.atom "dev_traffic_signal_shows" [.var d, .lit "flashing_red"] []))

/-- s7: r is an entrance to a through highway — governed by a stop sign, a yield sign or a
    flashing-red signal. `sfx` keeps the device variables of each call apart. -/
def entranceDevice (r sfx : String) : Formula :=
  .or (stopSignOn r ("dS" ++ sfx)) (.or (yieldSignOn r ("dY" ++ sfx)) (flashingRedOn r ("dR" ++ sfx)))

  .or (stopSignOn r ("dHS" ++ sfx)) (flashingRedOn r ("dHR" ++ sfx))

    within the horizon, below the centre clearance. -/

  .and (.derived "prim_closest_approach_within" [.var a, .var b] [pConflictHorizon])
    (.cmp (.quantity "prim_closest_approach_distance" [.var a, .var b] [pConflictHorizon]) .lt
      pConflictCentreClearance)

/-- rel.contact. -/
def contact (a b : String) : Formula := .atom "rel_contact" [.var a, .var b] []

/-- s2 (ii): o proceeds in danger of a crash with, or touches, some vehicle v ≠ o that occupies j
    or a carrier entering j governed by no entrance device. -/
def throughConflict (o j : String) : Formula :=
  .existsUser "v"
    (.and (.not (.same (.var "v") (.var o)))
      (.and (isVehicle "v")
        (.and
          (.or (occupies "v" j)
            (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "c3"
              (.and (occupies "v" "c3") (.and (entersJ "c3" j) (.not (entranceDevice "c3" "3"))))))
          (.or (.and (proceeds o) (closeApproach o "v")) (contact o "v")))))

/-- s2 (ii), at one observation: o occupies c2 or j, and before entering j it is in no conflict. -/
def onApproach (o c2 j : String) : Formula :=
  .and (.or (occupies o c2) (occupies o j)) (.or (occupies o j) (.not (throughConflict o j)))

/-- s2: o has so yielded since its occupancy of c2 last rose. -/
def soYielded (o c2 j : String) : Formula :=
  .and (.since (onApproach o c2 j) (.and (.rises (occupies o c2)) (onApproach o c2 j)))
    (.implies (haltDevice c2 "2")
      (.since (.not (.rises (occupies o c2)))
        (.and (.derived "drv_motion_complete_halt" [.var o] [pHaltSpeedTolerance])
          (.and (occupies o c2) (.not (occupies o j))))))

/-- s1, s2, s10: o is a vehicle other than the subject, coming from a carrier c2 entering j with an
    entrance device, in j or entering it within the horizon, having so yielded. -/
def enteringVehicle (o j : String) : Formula :=
  .and (.not (.same (.var o) vSubject))
    (.and (isVehicle o)
      (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "c2"
        (.and (entersJ "c2" j)
          (.and (entranceDevice "c2" "2")
            (.and
              (.or (occupies o j)
                (.and (occupies o "c2") (.within .time pConflictHorizon o (occupies o j))))
              (soYielded o "c2" j))))))

/-- s6, s7: the subject approaches j through a carrier c with no entrance device. -/
def throughApproach (c j : String) : Formula :=
  .and (occupies "subject" c) (.and (entersJ c j) (.not (entranceDevice c "1")))

/-- s8, s9: the subject grants precedence to o. -/
def yieldsTo (o : String) : Formula :=
  .and (.not (.and (proceeds "subject") (closeApproach "subject" o))) (.not (contact "subject" o))

/-- Class of `subject`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle -/
def clsSubject : Formula := isVehicle "subject"

/-- Applicability: s1 (condition): Said driver; s2 (condition): having so yielded; s3 (condition): may proceed; s6 (trigger): approaching the intersection; s7 (condition): on the through highway; s10 (condition): to the vehicle about to enter or cross the through highway -/
def applicability : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "intersection") "j"
    (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "c"
      (.and (throughApproach "c" "j") (.existsUser "o" (enteringVehicle "o" "j"))))

/-- Obligation: s8 (obligation): shall yield; s9 (standard): right-of-way -/
def obligation : Formula :=
  .forallRegion (.lit "intersection") "j"
    (.forallRegion (.lit "travel_region") "c"
      (.implies (throughApproach "c" "j")
        (.forallUser "o" (.implies (enteringVehicle "o" "j") (yieldsTo "o")))))

def rule : Rule :=
  { id := "LVMC_11_12_070_B"
    laws := ["LVMC-11-12-070-B"]
    binders :=
      [ { name := "subject", cls := clsSubject } ]
    applicability := applicability
    obligation := obligation
    assumptions := []
    intentions := []
    operationalizations :=
      [ { standard := "right-of-way: DEF-NRS-484A-210 'approaching under such circumstances of direction, speed and proximity as to give rise to the danger of a crash unless one grants precedence to the other'"
          concepts := ["kin.speed", "prim.closest_approach_distance", "prim.closest_approach_within"]
          params := ["p.conflict_horizon", "p.conflict_centre_clearance", "p.halt_speed_tolerance"]
          convention := "traffic-conflict technique: a danger of a crash exists where, under constant velocities, the centres of the two road users come within a centre clearance comparable to their half-extents inside a time-to-collision horizon; a road user whose speed is at or below the source's speed resolution has granted precedence"
          surrogate := false } ]
    residues := ["a permission granted to the entering driver; it imposes no condition on the through-highway drivers beyond the entering vehicle's movement, which s10 carries, so the duty is the same whether or not the permission is read"]  -- the node's, verbatim; not yours to change
    narrowings := []
    surrogate := false }

end TrafficSpec.Rules.LVMC_11_12_070_B

    - through lane c (region 11): x ∈ [-30, -5], y ∈ [-5, 0], eastbound, enters j; no device

    - cross lane c2 (region 12): x ∈ [0, 5], y ∈ [-10, -5], northbound, enters j; stop sign 20
      governs it (a yield sign in branch_4, a flashing-red signal in branch_5/6).
    - subject (track 1): a car eastbound along y = -2.5 m; the entering vehicle o (track 2): a car
      northbound along x = 2.5 m; w (track 3, branch_7): a car eastbound along y = -2.5 m.

-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.LVMC_11.LVMC_11_12_070_B
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.LVMC_11_12_070_B

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
/-- Decimetres, for positions. -/
def dm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres (n * 10)
/-- Tenths of a metre per second, for speeds. -/
def tenthMps (n : Int) : Q := Units.micrometresPerSecond (n * 100000)

def carHalfExtent : Q × Q × Q := (cm 230, cm 100, cm 75)

def car (track : TrackId) (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (v : Int) : RoadUser :=
  Build.user track [.motorVehicle] pos heading (tenthMps v) carHalfExtent

def intersectionJ : Structure := Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-5)) (m (-5)) (m 5) (m 5)
def throughLane : Structure :=
  Build.lane 11 [(m (-30), m (-5)), (m (-5), m (-5)), (m (-5), m 0), (m (-30), m 0)] Build.east
    (enters := some 10)
def crossLane : Structure :=
  Build.lane 12 [(m 0, m (-10)), (m 5, m (-10)), (m 5, m (-5)), (m 0, m (-5))] Build.north
    (enters := some 10)
def layout : List Structure := [intersectionJ, throughLane, crossLane]

    o's (y in dm, speed in 0.1 m/s) on x = 2.5 m northbound (absent where the list ends), and any
    further users. -/

    (extra : Nat → List RoadUser := fun _ => []) : Trace :=

    (Build.trace subj.length 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
      let s := subj.getD k (0, 0)
      let subjU := car 1 (dm s.1, dm (-25)) Build.east s.2
      let others :=
        if k < oth.length then
          let o := oth.getD k (0, 0)
          [car 2 (dm 25, dm o.1) Build.north o.2]
        else []

    (Units.seconds 2) (Units.seconds 4) (Units.seconds 1)

  [(-120, 30), (-95, 20), (-75, 0), (-75, 0), (-65, 10), (-45, 15), (-35, 10), (-25, 5)]

/-- o slows on c2 but never below 0.8 m/s, in j from 5 s. -/

  [(-120, 30), (-95, 20), (-80, 15), (-70, 10), (-62, 8), (-45, 15), (-35, 10), (-25, 5)]

/-- `permit` (compliant): Same scene; the subject brakes to a halt short of j while o crosses; while the closest approach is below the clearance the subject's speed is at or below p.halt_speed_tolerance, and no contact occurs. -/

     (-260, 20), (-250, 0), (-250, 0), (-250, 0)]
    (oHalts ++ [(-10, 20), (15, 30), (45, 30), (80, 30)])
    [stopOnCross]

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The subject approaches j on the through approach, but no vehicle is on or entering from a stop-sign or yield-sign approach of j. -/
def idleTrace : Trace :=
  episode [(-280, 80), (-200, 80), (-130, 60), (-80, 40)] [] [stopOnCross]

/-- `blind` (unknown): As forbid, but the source does not observe which carriers the stop sign governs, so whether o's approach is an entrance to a through highway is unknown. -/

def branch_1Trace : Trace :=
  episode subjForbid oHalts [stopOnCross, Build.sign 21 .stopSign [11]]

/-- `branch_2` (not_applicable): As forbid, except that o never comes to rest at its stop sign before entering j: it has not so yielded, and the duty does not arise. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace := episode subjForbid oRolls [stopOnCross]

    x = -25 m, 10 m/s: closest approach after 2.71 s at 1.96 m. -/

  episode [(-650, 100), (-550, 100), (-450, 100), (-350, 100), (-250, 100), (-150, 100)]
    [(-120, 30), (-95, 20), (-75, 0), (-75, 0), (-60, 20), (-40, 20)]
    [stopOnCross]

/-- `branch_4` (violated): o's approach is governed by a yield sign; o slows without halting (no
    halt is required there) and enters j; the subject arrives as in forbid. -/
def branch_4Trace : Trace := episode subjForbid oRolls [Build.sign 20 .yieldSign [12]]

  [Build.signal 30 [12] [.flashingRed], Build.signal 31 [11] [.flashingYellow]]

/-- `branch_5` (violated): o's approach is governed by a signal showing flashing red (the

/-- w, eastbound at 10 m/s: through lane at 2–3 s, in j at 4 s (x = -2 m), past j after. -/
def wCrossing (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  let xs : List Int := [-420, -320, -220, -120, -20, 80, 180, 280]

    yielded; the subject later arrives as in forbid. -/
def branch_7Trace : Trace :=
  episode subjForbid
    [(-120, 30), (-95, 20), (-75, 0), (-75, 0), (-55, 20), (-40, 10), (-32, 8), (-25, 5)]
    [stopOnCross] wCrossing

/-- `branch_8` (compliant): o waits at rest on c2 at the stop sign and enters j at 6 s; at 3–5 s it is
    about to enter (within the horizon) and the subject, creeping at 1 m/s on the through lane

def branch_8Trace : Trace :=
  episode [(-290, 10), (-280, 10), (-270, 10), (-260, 10), (-250, 10), (-240, 10), (-230, 10)]
    [(-120, 30), (-95, 20), (-75, 0), (-75, 0), (-75, 0), (-75, 0), (-45, 20)]
    [stopOnCross]

    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "")
    (window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := none) : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "LVMC_11_12_070_B"
    trace := τ
    reading := {}          -- ignored by the gate: the run's reading is substituted
    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("subject", 1)]
    expected := expected
    window := window
    boundary := boundary }

  [ witness "forbid" forbidTrace .violated (window := upTo 8)
  , witness "permit" permitTrace .compliant (window := upTo 12)
  , witness "idle" idleTrace .notApplicable (window := upTo 4)

  , witness "branch_3" branch_3Trace .notApplicable (window := upTo 6)
  , witness "branch_4" branch_4Trace .violated (window := upTo 8)
  , witness "branch_5" branch_5Trace .violated (window := upTo 8)

  , witness "branch_8" branch_8Trace .compliant (window := some (3000, 5000)) ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.LVMC_11_12_070_B

import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Tri
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Handles

namespace TrafficSpec

inductive UnknownReason

  | windowTruncated (op : String)         -- the window reaches past the start or end of the trace
  | identityGap (track : TrackId)         -- a bound track is not present and no link continues it
  | assumptionMissing (id : AsmId)        -- an `asm.*` the scene did not supply
  | intentionMissing (id : IntId)         -- an `int.*` the scene did not declare for the road user at the region
  | parameterMissing (name : String)      -- a reading parameter the rule names but the reading lacks
  | unboundVariable (name : String)       -- a formula variable with no binding
  | compositionUnknown (rule : String)    -- a composed rule reported unknown or does not exist
  | outOfRange                            -- an index outside the trace
  | divisionByZero (what : String)
  | malformed (what : String)             -- a literal that names no enumeration value, wrong arity
  | undefined (concept : String)          -- the concept's precondition does not hold here (e.g. a multi-lane configuration)
  | aggregateUnresolved (id : String)     -- the posted definition of the aggregate decides neither inclusion nor exclusion of the road user's class
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace UnknownReason
/-- A stable spelling for reports and histograms. -/
def tag : UnknownReason → String
  | .absentAtom n => s!"absent_atom:{n}"
  | .samplingGap op => s!"sampling_gap:{op}"
  | .windowTruncated op => s!"window_truncated:{op}"
  | .identityGap t => s!"identity_gap:{t}"
  | .assumptionMissing id => s!"assumption_missing:{id}"
  | .intentionMissing id => s!"intention_missing:{id}"
  | .parameterMissing n => s!"parameter_missing:{n}"
  | .unboundVariable n => s!"unbound_variable:{n}"
  | .compositionUnknown r => s!"composition_unknown:{r}"
  | .outOfRange => "out_of_range"
  | .divisionByZero w => s!"division_by_zero:{w}"
  | .malformed w => s!"malformed:{w}"
  | .undefined c => s!"undefined:{c}"
  | .aggregateUnresolved id => s!"aggregate_unresolved:{id}"
instance : ToString UnknownReason := ⟨tag⟩
end UnknownReason

/-- A three-valued result with the reasons behind an unknown one. -/
structure R where
  v : Tri
  why : List UnknownReason := []
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace R
def t : R := ⟨.t, []⟩
def f : R := ⟨.f, []⟩
def u (w : UnknownReason) : R := ⟨.u, [w]⟩
def ofBool (b : Bool) : R := ⟨Tri.ofBool b, []⟩
def ofOption (o : Option Bool) (w : UnknownReason) : R :=
  match o with
  | some b => ofBool b
  | none => u w
/-- Reasons are kept only while the value is undecided. -/
def settle (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : R := ⟨v, if v = .u then why.eraseDups else []⟩
@[simp] theorem settle_v (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : (settle v why).v = v := rfl
def and (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.and a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
def or (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.or a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
def not (a : R) : R := ⟨Tri.not a.v, a.why⟩
@[simp] theorem and_v (a b : R) : (and a b).v = Tri.and a.v b.v := rfl
@[simp] theorem or_v (a b : R) : (or a b).v = Tri.or a.v b.v := rfl
@[simp] theorem not_v (a : R) : (not a).v = Tri.not a.v := rfl

def all (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl and t
def any (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl or f
/-- Lift an `Option α` into a computation that is unknown when the option is empty. -/
def bindOpt {α : Type} (o : Option α) (w : UnknownReason) (k : α → R) : R :=

  | some a => k a
  | none => u w
end R

abbrev QR := Except UnknownReason Q

structure RangeAgg where
  vals : Array R
  prefF : Array Nat      -- prefF[i] = number of false values before index i

def build (vals : Array R) : RangeAgg :=
  let n := vals.size

    acc.set! i (if vals[i]!.v = .u then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)

private def firstUnknown (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : List UnknownReason :=
  let k := a.nextU[lo]!
  if k ≤ hi then a.vals[k]!.why else []

/-- ∧ over `lo … hi` inclusive; true on an empty range. -/
def all (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
  if hi < lo then R.t
  else if cnt a.prefF lo hi > 0 then R.f
  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
  else R.t
/-- ∨ over `lo … hi` inclusive; false on an empty range. -/
def any (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
  if hi < lo then R.f
  else if cnt a.prefT lo hi > 0 then R.t
  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
  else R.f

/-- The number of values among the first `m` that satisfy `p`: what `build` stores at `m`. -/
def countTo (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | m + 1 => countTo vals p m + (if p vals[m]!.v then 1 else 0)

private theorem count_fold (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (k : Nat) :
    ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]).size = k + 1 ∧
    ∀ m, m ≤ k → ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
      acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0])[m]! = countTo vals p m := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [countTo]
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hs, hv⟩ := ih
    simp only [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
    refine ⟨by simp [hs], fun m hm => ?_⟩
    rw [getElem!_pos _ m (by simp; omega), Array.getElem_push]
    split
    · rw [← getElem!_pos _ m (by omega)]; exact hv m (by omega)
    · obtain rfl : m = k + 1 := by omega
      simp only [countTo]; rw [hv k (Nat.le_refl _)]

theorem countTo_mono (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) {a b : Nat} (h : a ≤ b) :
    countTo vals p a ≤ countTo vals p b := by
  induction b with
  | zero => cases h; exact Nat.le_refl _
  | succ b ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge a (b + 1) with h' | h'
    · exact Nat.le_trans (ih (by omega)) (by simp only [countTo]; omega)
    · obtain rfl : a = b + 1 := by omega
      exact Nat.le_refl _

/-- The count rises between `lo` and `n` exactly when a value at an index in `[lo, n)` satisfies `p`. -/
theorem countTo_lt_iff (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (lo n : Nat) :
    countTo vals p lo < countTo vals p n ↔ ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j < n ∧ p vals[j]!.v := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [countTo] at h
    | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hp : p vals[n]!.v
      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n lo with h' | h'
        · have := countTo_mono vals p (show n + 1 ≤ lo by omega); omega
        · exact ⟨n, h', Nat.lt_succ_self _, hp⟩
      · simp only [countTo, hp] at h
        obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (by simpa using h)
        exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, h3⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩
    have a := countTo_mono vals p h1
    have b := countTo_mono vals p (show j + 1 ≤ n by omega)
    have c : countTo vals p (j + 1) = countTo vals p j + 1 := by simp [countTo, h3]
    omega

private theorem cnt_build_f (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (hl : lo ≤ hi) (h : hi < vals.size) :
    cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi = countTo vals (· = .f) (hi + 1) - countTo vals (· = .f) lo := by
  have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
  simp only [cnt, build]
  rw [hf.2 (hi + 1) (by omega), hf.2 lo (by omega)]

/-- `all` is false only on a definite false in the range. -/
theorem all_f_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (h : ((build vals).all lo hi).v = .f) :
    ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j ≤ hi ∧ j < vals.size ∧ vals[j]!.v = .f := by
  have hl : lo ≤ hi := by
    refine Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hn => ?_
    simp only [all, hn, if_true] at h
    exact absurd h (by decide)
  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
    refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hn => ?_
    simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hn, Nat.lt_irrefl] at h
    split at h <;> simp [R.t] at h
  have hhi : hi < vals.size := by
    refine Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hn => ?_
    have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
    have : (build vals).prefF[hi + 1]! = 0 := by
      simp only [build]; rw [getElem!_neg]; · rfl
      rw [hf.1]; omega
    simp only [cnt, this] at hc
    omega
  rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi hl hhi] at hc
  obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).1 (by omega)
  exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, by omega, by simpa using h3⟩

/-- A definite false in a range inside the array makes `all` false. -/
theorem all_f_of_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi j : Nat) (hhi : hi < vals.size) (hlo : lo ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ hi)
    (hf : vals[j]!.v = .f) : (build vals).all lo hi = R.f := by
  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
    rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi (by omega) hhi]
    have := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).2 ⟨j, hlo, by omega, by simp [hf]⟩
    omega
  simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hc, if_true]
end RangeAgg

end TrafficSpec

def devicesOf (c : SemCtx) (k : DeviceKind) : List DeviceId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap fun s => deviceCandidates s k).eraseDups
/-- At each instant, whether the region is of the kind: true, false, or unknown where the source
    cannot tell the kind. A quantifier conjoins it with its body, so a region the source cannot
    place in the kind makes the quantifier unknown, never decided by its absence. -/
def regionIsKind (c : SemCtx) (r : RegionId) (k : StructureKind) : Array R :=
  c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (isKind s r k) (.absentAtom s!"st_{k}")
def deviceIsKind (c : SemCtx) (d : DeviceId) (k : DeviceKind) : Array R :=
  c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (devKind s d k) (.absentAtom s!"dev_{k}")
/-- Every road user present in some scene of the trace. -/
def usersOf (c : SemCtx) : List TrackId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups

/-- The kind a quantifier ranges over: a spelling of the ontology. A variable here is a concept's
    literal formal that no expansion filled. -/
def regionKindOf (a : Arg) : Except UnknownReason StructureKind :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => match StructureKind.ofString s with | some k => .ok k | none => .error (.malformed s!"region kind {s}")
  | .var v => .error (.malformed s!"region kind `{v}` is a variable")
  | .nat _ => .error (.malformed "region kind")
def deviceKindOf (a : Arg) : Except UnknownReason DeviceKind :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => match DeviceKind.ofString s with | some k => .ok k | none => .error (.malformed s!"device kind {s}")
  | .var v => .error (.malformed s!"device kind `{v}` is a variable")
  | .nat _ => .error (.malformed "device kind")

/-- φ where the precondition holds; undefined where it is false; the precondition's reasons where
    it is unknown. -/
def definedWhenR (pre x : R) : R :=
  match pre.v with
  | .t => x
  | .f => R.u (.undefined "defined_when")
  | .u => ⟨.u, pre.why⟩

/-- A selection at one instant: the branch the guard picks; where the guard is unknown, the
    branches' common value, else unknown with the guard's reasons. -/
def condAt (g : R) (a b : QR) : QR :=
  match g.v with
  | .t => a
  | .f => b
  | .u => match a, b with
    | .ok x, .ok y => if Q.eq x y then .ok x else .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))
    | _, _ => .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))

/-- An aggregate over the members present at one instant: unknown when a member's membership is
    unknown or a member's value is; `count` on an empty set is zero, the others are undefined. -/
def aggregateAt (op : AggOp) (xs : List (R × QR)) : QR :=
  match xs.find? (fun (f, _) => f.v == .u) with
  | some (f, _) => .error (f.why.head?.getD (.malformed "aggregate"))
  | none =>
    let vals := xs.filterMap fun (f, q) => if f.v == .t then some q else none
    match op with
    | .count => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat vals.length))
    | _ => do
      let qs ← vals.mapM fun q => q
      if qs.isEmpty then .error (.undefined "aggregate")
      else
        let sorted := qs.toArray.qsort (fun a b => Q.lt a b)
        match op with
        | .min => .ok sorted[0]!
        | .max => .ok sorted[sorted.size - 1]!
        | _ => .ok sorted[sorted.size / 2]!

/-- Membership of a road user in a legal aggregate at one scene: true when it carries an included
    class; unknown, with the observation's reason, when an included or unresolved class it might
    carry is unobserved; unknown as `aggregateUnresolved` when it carries a class the definition
    leaves unresolved; false otherwise. -/
def aggregateMembership (s : Scene) (t : TrackId) (a : LegalAggregate) : R :=
  let classes := fun (ids : List String) => ids.filterMap fun i => RoadUserClass.ofString (i.drop 3).toString
  match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.included) with
  | some true => R.t
  | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")
  | some false =>
    match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.unresolved) with
    | some true => R.u (.aggregateUnresolved a.id)
    | some false => R.f
    | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")

/-- Kleene aggregate at each instant over the evaluated members present in that scene. -/
def perScene (c : SemCtx) (evaluated : List (Nat × Array R))
    (presentIn : Scene → Nat → Bool) (agg : List R → R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
    let s := c.scenes[i]!
    agg (evaluated.filterMap fun (m, arr) => if presentIn s m then some arr[i]! else none)

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.LVMC_11_12_070_B

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/
def vSubject : Arg := .var "subject"

/-- The reading's parameters; no value of any of them lives in this file. -/
def pConflictCentreClearance : Term := .param "p.conflict_centre_clearance"
def pConflictHorizon : Term := .param "p.conflict_horizon"
def pHaltSpeedTolerance : Term := .param "p.halt_speed_tolerance"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

def vehicleAggregate : String := "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"

/-- rel.occupies. -/

/-- st.lane_enters: carrier c is an approach to intersection j. -/

/-- dev.governs. -/
def governs (d r : String) : Formula := .atom "dev_governs" [.var d, .var r] []

/-- A stop sign governs r. -/
def stopSignOn (r d : String) : Formula := .existsDevice (.lit "stop_sign") d (governs d r)

/-- A yield sign governs r. -/
def yieldSignOn (r d : String) : Formula := .existsDevice (.lit "yield_sign") d (governs d r)

/-- A traffic signal showing flashing_red governs r. -/
def flashingRedOn (r d : String) : Formula :=
  .existsDevice (.lit "traffic_signal") d
    (.and (governs d r) (.atom "dev_traffic_signal_shows" [.var d, .lit "flashing_red"] []))

def entranceDevice (r sfx : String) : Formula :=

    within the horizon, below the centre clearance. -/

    or a carrier entering j governed by no entrance device. -/

    (.and (.not (.same (.var "v") (.var o)))
      (.and (isVehicle "v")
        (.and

  .and (.or (occupies o c2) (occupies o j)) (.or (occupies o j) (.not (throughConflict o j)))

    (.implies (haltDevice c2 "2")
      (.since (.not (.rises (occupies o c2)))
        (.and (.derived "drv_motion_complete_halt" [.var o] [pHaltSpeedTolerance])
          (.and (occupies o c2) (.not (occupies o j))))))

        (.and (.not (.same (.var "c2") (.var j))) (.and (entersJ "c2" j)

    (extra : Nat → List RoadUser := fun _ => []) (structs : List Structure := layout)
    (subjY : Int := -25) : Trace :=
  Build.pad
    (Build.trace subj.length 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
      let s := subj.getD k (0, 0)
      let subjU := car 1 (dm s.1, dm subjY) Build.east s.2
      let others :=
        if k < oth.length then
          let o := oth.getD k (0, 0)
          [car 2 (dm 25, dm o.1) Build.north o.2]
        else []
      Build.scene t (some 1) (subjU :: others ++ extra k) structs devs)
    (Units.seconds 2) (Units.seconds 4) (Units.seconds 1)

/-- The cross lane c2 lengthened to y ∈ [-20, -5] m, so a follower can queue on it behind o. -/
def crossLaneLong : Structure :=
  Build.lane 12 [(m 0, m (-20)), (m 5, m (-20)), (m 5, m (-5)), (m 0, m (-5))] Build.north
    (enters := some 10)
def layoutLong : List Structure := [intersectionJ, throughLane, crossLaneLong]

/-- An exit lane north of j (x ∈ [0, 5], y ∈ [5, 30], northbound), an approach to the next
    intersection (region 14, y ∈ [30, 40]), not to j. -/
def exitLane : Structure :=
  Build.lane 13 [(m 0, m 5), (m 5, m 5), (m 5, m 30), (m 0, m 30)] Build.north (enters := some 14)
def nextJunction : Structure := Build.rect 14 .intersection (m (-5)) (m 30) (m 5) (m 40)
def layoutExit : List Structure := layout ++ [exitLane, nextJunction]

/-- A southbound approach to j from the north (x ∈ [-5, 0], y ∈ [5, 20]). -/
def northApproach : Structure :=
  Build.lane 15 [(m (-5), m 5), (m 0, m 5), (m 0, m 20), (m (-5), m 20)] Build.south
    (enters := some 10)
def layoutNorth : List Structure := layout ++ [northApproach]
